_meta.note: 單位素材表。每一列 = 一個單位，每一欄 = 損傷程度（完好 / 受損 / 重創）。同一列必須是同一個單位只是損傷不同 —— 這是把三個狀態塞進同一次生成的唯一理由，分次生成必然漂移。切圖器見 tools/slice-sheets.mjs。
_meta.grid: prompt 裡宣告的列數與欄數，必須和 tools/slice-sheets.mjs 的 SHEETS 設定一致

items.name: 我方小隊素材表
items.prompt: A square 1:1 game asset sheet containing exactly 9 top-down military science-fiction infantry tokens, laid out in a clean 3 by 3 grid: 3 rows and 3 columns, with equal generous flat magenta gaps between every subject. No subject may touch, overlap or cast anything onto another. All 9 subjects are drawn at exactly the same scale, each one centred in its own invisible cell, each with a compact footprint that would fit inside a circle. Every figure is seen from STRAIGHT OVERHEAD: you see the top of the helmet, the tops of the shoulders and the weapon foreshortened flat against the body. Within each row the armour design, the colour scheme, the equipment and the silhouette are IDENTICAL - it is the exact same soldier three times - and ONLY the battle damage changes across the columns. Column 1 (left) = pristine, undamaged, fully intact armour. Column 2 (middle) = moderately damaged: armour plates dented and scorched black, one shoulder plate cracked open, a thin wisp of smoke. Column 3 (right) = critically damaged: armour shattered open, internal structural frame exposed, torn cabling hanging loose, sparks and glowing orange hot fractures. ROW 1 is a VANGUARD assault trooper: bulky heavy frontline exosuit, very thick angular shoulder pauldrons, a short stubby close-quarters weapon held across the chest, a narrow cyan-blue glowing visor slit on the helmet and thin cyan-blue trim strips along the shoulders. ROW 2 is a SNIPER marksman: slim lightweight low-profile recon suit, a long-barrelled precision rifle extending forward past the head, a ragged hooded camouflage cloak draped over the back, a single cyan-blue glowing optic lens. ROW 3 is an ENGINEER support trooper: medium-weight suit with a bulky rectangular backpack module and a short antenna, a compact carbine in one hand and a segmented mechanical tool arm on the other side, small cyan-blue indicator lights on the backpack

items.name: 徽章 起步 4 枚
items.style_override: Style: stamped military unit insignia for a hard science-fiction tactics game — issued equipment, not fantasy heraldry. Each emblem is a circular metal badge seen perfectly flat straight-on, no perspective, no tilt. Palette strictly gunmetal grey #3A4750, worn steel #6B7B8C, olive drab #5A6650, muted brass #A8895A and cold cyan #5DB6FF used sparingly as a single indicator accent. ⚠️ NO pink, NO magenta, NO crimson, NO red in any emblem — reserved for the cutout background. ⚠️ FORBIDDEN motifs: swords, crested shields, skulls, dragons, crowns, treasure chests, wands, trophies, keys, hearts, flames, hourglasses, wings. Use only flat geometric and technical shapes: arrows, chevrons, rings, bars, triangles, reticles, circuits, stencilled marks. Bold heavy stamped strokes, large simple shapes, readable at 64 pixels AND readable in pure greyscale — the meaning must live in the SHAPE, never the colour. Slight paint wear and scuffing on the metal is fine. No hairlines, no fine detail, no soft drop shadow, no glow. Background MUST be one flat uniform pure magenta #FF00FF field with nothing else on it: no gradient, no vignette, no shadow falling onto the magenta, no glow bleeding onto it. Badges fully separated by empty magenta space. No text, no letters, no numbers, no roman numerals, no tally marks, no watermark.
items.prompt: A square 1:1 asset sheet with exactly 4 circular stamped metal unit badges in a clean 2 by 2 grid, 2 rows and 2 columns, with wide flat magenta gaps between them. No badge touches another. All 4 are the same diameter, each centred in its own invisible cell. Every badge is a plain circular disc with a plain narrow raised rim, carrying ONE bold stamped geometric emblem in the centre. Reading left to right, top row first, the four emblems are: 1 a power-on symbol: a thick broken ring with a vertical bar rising through the gap at its top. 2 a thick closed circular ring with a bold check mark inside it. 3 a wide rectangular drawer seen head-on with a thick arrow pointing down into it. 4 two crossed spanners laid over a single cog wheel.
